analysis_set.span: The time to first hospitalization due to worsening heart failure was estimated using the Kaplan–Meier method, on the full-analysis set.

follow_up.span: Importantly, patients treated with FCM demonstrated significantly reduced risk of hospital admission due to worsening HF during 1-year follow-up.

entry_age.span: At least 18 years of age and with written informed consent prior to any study specific procedures

notes: FAS included 150 FCM and 151 placebo patients, excluding three randomized patients without post-baseline efficacy assessments; unqualified ITT is imprecise. The served estimate is a first-event HR, not RR. Participants and registry eligibility disclose no criterion clearly outside the packet question; LVEF eligibility was ≤45%.
